text.p: Motorola Inc on Tuesday said it was restructuring its Semiconductor Products Sector into four market-based groups and a separate Semiconductor Components Group.

The unit will now consist of Consumer Systems Group, Networking & Computing Systems Group, Transportation Systems Group, Wireless Subscriber Systems Group, as well as a Semiconductor Components Group.
The focus of the restructuring is to offer integrated products and services for specific market segments, the company said. It will be phased during the rest of 1997.

"We are in an excellent position to leverage our broad portfolio of technologies, strong software expertise and extensive applications knowledge to support a new generation of applications," Hector Ruiz, executive vice president of Motorola and president of SPS, said in a statement.
The new Consumer Systems Group will be based in Hong Kong, and the Semiconductor Components Group will have its headquarters in Geneva. The other three groups will be based in Austin, Texas.
Motorola said it was the first time any of its operating groups have had headquarters outside of the United States.
